Term2: Vaccines in bone marrow transplant patients
Text:
# BONE MARROW POST-TRANSPLANT VACCINATION

**St. Cloud Guidance:**

RECOMMENDATIONS NOT AVAILABLE
Recommendations for this condition are not available within CDSS. Please refer to facility guidelines or other clinical resources for recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

Seasonal influenza vaccination should be administered yearly. Patient should be administered COVID-19 vaccinations to be up-to-date per current CDC guidelines.

Influenza and COVID-19 vaccinations may be administered via nursing standing orders.

Order sets are available below for other post-transplant vaccine regimens.

Choose vaccine regimen based on location where transplant was performed and type of transplantation.
